meta.source: Extracted from site/styles.css and site/index.html, about.html, contact.html, services-and-pricing.html in this repo (main branch, 2026-09-25). Companion to tokens.css in this folder.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas — body background.

tokens.name: bg-soft
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (.section-alt) used to break up long pages, e.g. the "Why Yowie" split section.

tokens.name: bg-footer
tokens.usage: Site footer and the fixed mobile contact bar — the darkest surface in the system.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Card, hero-card, feature-panel, pricing-card and Google-reviews panel fills.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface-card — headings, body copy, nav active state text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — lead paragraphs, subheadings, captions, inactive nav links, list copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand gold. Eyebrow labels, text links, prices, focus outlines, primary button fill, active nav pill fill.

tokens.name: accent-dark
tokens.usage: Deep gold from the wordmark gradient. Declared in the source stylesheet but not yet applied to any component — reserved for a pressed/hover state on accent-filled buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour on accent-filled surfaces — primary button label, pricing badge text, active nav pill text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline — card borders, header/footer rules, list dividers, secondary button border.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border for bordered buttons/cards on dark surfaces (e.g. the hero "Call now" button).

tokens.name: sms-green
tokens.usage: Secondary brand action colour — fill for every "Text us" SMS call-to-action button.

tokens.name: sms-green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for sms-green buttons.

tokens.name: on-sms
tokens.usage: Text on sms-green fills. Source pairing measures ~3.2:1 against sms-green — below the 4.5:1 body-text floor. Keep this combination to short, bold button labels only and never use it for body copy. Carried through exactly as built — flagged, not re-tinted.

tokens.name: green-wash-weak
tokens.usage: Background wash for the concierge-perk note on the Mobile Concierge page.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Background for the header "Text us" nav pill (default state).

tokens.name: green-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Background for the header "Text us" nav pill (hover state).

tokens.name: green-line
tokens.usage: Border for the concierge-banner and concierge-perk panels.

tokens.name: green-line-strong
tokens.usage: Border for the header "Text us" nav pill (default state).

tokens.name: green-line-hover
tokens.usage: Border for the header "Text us" nav pill (hover state).

tokens.name: accent-line-strong
tokens.usage: Border on the featured ("MOST POPULAR") pricing card.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Inset ring layered into the featured pricing card's box-shadow, alongside shadow-card.

tokens.name: gradient-hero-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the hero / page-hero background gradient (down to bg).

tokens.name: gradient-gold-deep
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the warm diagonal gradient behind the "Get in touch" callout and the cancellation-policy panel.

tokens.name: gradient-base
tokens.usage: Shared near-black gradient stop used as the second stop in the callout/policy gradient and the middle stop in the concierge-banner gradient.

tokens.name: gradient-green-deep
tokens.usage: First stop of the three-colour concierge-banner gradient.

tokens.name: gradient-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Final stop of the three-colour concierge-banner gradient (cool end, balances the warm accent).

tokens.name: footer-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Default fill for footer social icon circles (Instagram, Facebook).

tokens.name: footer-icon-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for footer social icon circles.

tokens.name: footer-icon-border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border for footer social icon circles — ties the footer back to accent.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Fluid in source: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4.4rem) — scales from 38px on narrow phones up to this 70px ceiling; token holds the desktop ceiling.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings. Fluid in source: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem) — 29px to 42px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and sub-panel titles (pricing card titles, suspension card titles, feature-panel headings).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above headings ("What we do", "Why Yowie") — always in accent gold.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: "MOST POPULAR" pricing badge and the suspension-service eyebrow badges — uppercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero/section intro paragraph directly under a heading. Always muted colour, max-width 62ch.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running copy — the body element's own size; every unstyled paragraph.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Pricing-card highlight list items, service task list items, zone-card copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo captions, price notes ("Labour only", "+$30 for e-bikes"), suspension interval notes.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Pricing-card and suspension-card headline price. Fluid in source: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.2rem) — 28px to 35px.

styles.name: price-detail
styles.usage: Service-tier detail page inline price (e.g. on services-and-pricing.html breakdown sections).

spacing.note: Inferred: the source hand-writes rem paddings/margins with no shared scale. These nine steps rationalise the most-repeated real values for future consistency — flagged as an inference, not lifted verbatim from a token list in the CSS.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps — mobile bar button gap, footer icon gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: SMS/callout action row gaps, nav link gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card internal rhythm, hero-card padding, cta-row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pricing-grid and cards grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Feature-panel and pricing-card/suspension-card/zone-card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero-grid/split-grid column gap; callout and policy-callout padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding for the about-photo and find-us sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Standard .section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero section top padding — the largest rhythm step, used once.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline corner on the inline phone text link.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cream padding block behind the fork logo mark inside the hero card.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photo and embed corners — about-page photo, map embed, concierge-perk panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Primary card radius — .card, .hero-card, .feature-panel, .pricing-card, the Google reviews panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The largest panels — "Get in touch" callout and the cancellation-policy callout.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, nav link, and the pricing badge — the system's signature fully-rounded shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular footer social-icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Default lift under every card-family surface (card, hero-card, feature-panel, pricing-card, reviews panel).

tokens.name: shadow-image
tokens.usage: Deeper lift under photographic imagery — the about-page photo and the map embed.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky-bar
tokens.usage: Upward shadow cast by the fixed mobile contact bar over page content.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below this, callout action buttons stack full-width and centre their text.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Below this, the fixed mobile contact bar appears and the page gains bottom padding to clear it.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Below this, every two/three-column grid (hero, split, pricing, zone, suspension) collapses to one column and the header switches to a stacked layout.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky site header, kept above page content.

tokens.name: z-mobile-bar
tokens.usage: Fixed mobile contact bar, kept above the header and all page content.
